items.docs:
Returns the list of enabled typosquatting domains.

Required API key permissions: `BreachRisk` (select when creating API key in Account Settings)

info.name: Retrieve typosquat details for a domain.

params.name: domain
params.description: The domain for which to return typosquat details. e.g. "upguard.com"

items.docs:
If the requested domain is not enabled a 404 will be returned.
Use the /typosquat to retrieve the list of enabled domains first.

Required API key permissions: `BreachRisk` (select when creating API key in Account Settings)
